def style_lines(lines: List[Dict[str, Any]], columns: int,
    pre_processed_text: str='', start_line: str=' ' * 4, end_line: str=' ' * 4
    ) ->str:
    result = pre_processed_text

            value = word.get('value', '')
            style_opts = word.get('style', {})

def format_vulnerability(vulnerability: Any, full_mode: bool, only_text:
    bool=False, columns: int=get_terminal_size().columns) ->str:
    lines = []
    pkg = vulnerability.pkg
    requirements = pkg.requirements if pkg.requirements else []
    
    is_pinned = all(is_pinned_requirement(r.specifier) for r in requirements) if requirements else True
    
    if is_pinned:
        header = f'-> Vulnerability found in {pkg.name} version {pkg.version}'
    else:
        req_str = ', '.join(str(r.specifier) for r in requirements)
        header = f'-> Vulnerability may be present given that your {pkg.name} install specifier is\n   {req_str}'
    
    lines.append(header)
    lines.append(f'   Vulnerability ID: {vulnerability.vulnerability_id}')
    
    if vulnerability.ignored:
        lines.append('   This vulnerability is being ignored.')
        if vulnerability.ignored_expires:
            expires_str = vulnerability.ignored_expires.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') + ' UTC'
            lines.append(f'   This vulnerability is being ignored until {expires_str}. See your configurations.')
            if vulnerability.ignored_reason:
                lines.append(f'   Reason: {vulnerability.ignored_reason}')
        else:
            if vulnerability.ignored_reason:
                lines.append(f'   Reason: {vulnerability.ignored_reason}')
        lines.append('   For more information about this vulnerability, visit')
        lines.append(f'   {vulnerability.more_info_url}\n')
        result = '\n'.join(lines)
        return click.unstyle(result) if only_text else result
    
    lines.append(f'   Affected spec: {vulnerability.affected_versions}')
    lines.append(f'   ADVISORY: {vulnerability.advisory}')
    
    fixed_versions = vulnerability.fixed_versions
    if fixed_versions:
        lines.append(f'   Fixed versions: {", ".join(fixed_versions)}')
    else:
        lines.append('   Fixed versions: No known fix')
    
    cve = vulnerability.CVSSv2 or vulnerability.CVSSv3
    if vulnerability.CVSSv3 or vulnerability.CVSSv2:
        cvssv3 = vulnerability.CVSSv3
        cvssv2 = vulnerability.CVSSv2
        
        if cvssv3:
            severity = cvssv3.get('base_severity', '').upper()
            base_score = cvssv3.get('base_score', '')
            impact_score = cvssv3.get('impact_score', '')
            vector_string = cvssv3.get('vector_string', '')
            
            severity_line = f'   {vulnerability.cve_id} is {severity} SEVERITY => CVSS v3, BASE SCORE {base_score}, IMPACT'
            score_line = f'   SCORE {impact_score}, VECTOR STRING {vector_string}'
            lines.append(severity_line)
            lines.append(score_line)
        
        if cvssv2:
            base_score_v2 = cvssv2.get('base_score', '')
            impact_score_v2 = cvssv2.get('impact_score', '')
            vector_string_v2 = cvssv2.get('vector_string', '')
            lines.append(f'   CVSS v2, BASE SCORE {base_score_v2}, IMPACT SCORE {impact_score_v2}, VECTOR STRING')
            lines.append(f'   {vector_string_v2}')
    
    if not is_pinned:
        lines.append('   This vulnerability is present in your install specifier range.')
        lines.append('   To learn more about reporting these, specifier range handling, and')
        lines.append('   options for scanning unpinned packages visit')
        lines.append('   https://docs.pyup.io/docs/safety-range-specs')
    
    lines.append('   For more information about this vulnerability, visit')
    lines.append(f'   {vulnerability.more_info_url}')
    lines.append(f'   To ignore this vulnerability, use PyUp vulnerability id {vulnerability.vulnerability_id} in')
    lines.append('   safety\u2019s ignore command-line argument or add the ignore to your safety')
    lines.append('   policy file.\n')
    
    result = '\n'.join(lines)
    return click.unstyle(result) if only_text else result

def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    unstyled_text = click.unstyle(text)
    
    wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
        width=columns,
        initial_indent=indent,
        subsequent_indent=sub_indent if sub_indent else indent,
        break_long_words=False,
        break_on_hyphens=False,
    )
    
    wrapped = wrapper.fill(unstyled_text)
    
    if color and not styling:
        wrapped = click.style(wrapped, fg=color)
    elif styling:
        wrapped = click.style(wrapped, **styling)
    
    result = start_line_decorator + wrapped + end_line_decorator
    
    return result
